sources.title: Data monetisation / third-party sharing
sources.why: Directly governs sharing or selling health data to third parties, requiring explicit, separate, purpose-specific consent for each disclosure.

sources.title: ePrivacy Art. 5(3) — access to terminal equipment (cookies, SDKs, trackers)
sources.why: Third-party SDKs and trackers reading device data and transmitting it to advertisers or analytics require prior consent.

sources.title: GDPR Art. 9 — health data (special category)
sources.why: Disclosing special-category health data to any third party needs a valid Art. 9(2) condition, typically explicit consent.
